reason: During the day I drink the free office coffee, so I'm not paying 3 JOD at 11am. But it's right next to work, open till midnight and has 70 seats, so it could work for evenings with my friends. I'd try it a few times and see if the vibe holds up.
objection: It's in an office complex, so at night it might feel dead or like a work cafe instead of somewhere to sit with friends for three hours. And 3.50 to 4 JOD a drink every time I go out adds up on my salary.
would_change_my_mind: If I go once in the evening and it's empty or the seating is uncomfortable, I'd stop going. If there was a deal for groups or a cheaper refill when you sit for a long time, I'd go every week.
